thread:
maria_cs: kicking off horizon capacity bring-up for the dedicated pool. want to lock quotas + autoscale policy. baseline target ~1.2k RPS with planned burst to 5k for peak. planning load test next Wed 2026-04-12 22:00 UTC — who can be oncall and own rollback?

sam_eng: I can take infra lead. will prepare autoscale policy, fallback model mapping, and the runbook. pls share expected traffic profile (spikes vs steady).

liam_sre: heads up — we'll need 2x warm instances (warm pool) for KV cache priming or cold starts will spike p95. recommend a 30m warmup window before ramp.

natalie_pm: customer target is p95 <200ms. can we meet that with q8 quant and autoscale? I'll surface this to account so they can align expectations.

sam_eng: yes — we'll run a controlled experiment: q8 vs q4hf A/B. measure p95, error rate, and token-cost delta. I'll add config to infra repo `infra/horizon/autoscale.yaml`. sample config below:
```
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 12
cpu_target: 65
scale_window: 30s
fallback_model: smaller-model-v1
cache_prefill: true
```

maria_cs: added to runbook doc. opsbot: create loadtest ticket and assign owners.

opsbot: (automated) loadtest ticket LT-4521 created, assigned to sam_eng, liam_sre, maria_cs. scheduled Wed 2026-04-12 22:00 UTC.

liam_sre: I'll script the shadow traffic generator and preflight checks. plan: linear ramp 50 -> 1k RPS over 20m, hold, then step to 5k for 5m. sample cli snippet: `heyload --target https://horizon.redwood/api/generate --rps 50:1000 --duration 20m --concurrency 200`

natalie_pm: also capture a small prompt-regression eval set (50 golden prompts) to validate quality after quantization. maria, can you collect 10 high-priority customer prompts by EOD?

maria_cs: on it. I'll drop prompts in the Drive folder and link in LT-4521. adding customer notes: use org-specific prefixes and 3 response seeds.

sam_eng: preflight checklist I'm running tonight: KMS keys available, dedicated pool tagged `horizon-1`, quotas provisioned (GPU hours + network), network ACLs and egress rules confirmed. I'll run a 100 RPS smoke by EOD and post logs.

maria_cs: one more — rollback policy: if p95 >200ms AND prompt-regression >5% on eval set, immediate fallback to smaller-model-v1 and pause traffic. Everyone ok with that?

liam_sre: agreed. adding alert to paging: alert if p95 latency >200ms for 5m OR error rate >1% sustained for 3m. pager oncall: liam_sre -> sam_eng.

maria_cs: perfect. we'll reconvene 1h before the test for final signoff. tagging @natalie_pm for customer comms and @sam_eng for infra. :thumbsup:
